fact: ITWeb reports that Samsung Wallet users in South Africa can now pay by scanning QR codes through EFT Corp's Scan to Pay, which is accepted at more than 600 000 locations.

Capitec Pay is a bank-to-bank online payment service that lets clients pay on websites and apps using their phone number, and PayShap and the Rapid Payments Programme rail are named as competing payment rails (ITWeb, 6 August 2026).
PayInc says PayShap, South Africa's instant payments system launched in 2023, has passed six million registered users and 905 million transactions.
PayShap, South Africa's real-time payment platform, is in service and processed more than 500 million transactions worth about R486bn in 2025, per Absa's CEO.
ASAPP says it has proposed to the SARB how existing acquiring infrastructure could extend PayShap merchant acceptance and support wider adoption of instant payments.
